project_type: Vanilla JavaScript PWA (no build tools, no bundler)
language: JavaScript (ES5+ IIFE modules on window.LV namespace)
build_system: None - static files served directly. Script load order in index.html matters.
test_framework: None - verify with node --check for syntax validation
build_command: env -u NODE_OPTIONS node --check js/ui.js js/core.js js/app.js
test_command: env -u NODE_OPTIONS node --check js/ui.js js/core.js js/app.js
verification_instructions: Run: env -u NODE_OPTIONS node --check js/ui.js js/core.js js/app.js - all 3 files must pass syntax check without errors
setup_instructions: No setup needed - pure static web project
environment_constraints: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network - no npm install, no external packages. Node.js available for syntax checking only.
contribution_requirements: DO NOT modify any existing files. Only CREATE js/ui.js, js/core.js, js/app.js
key_patterns: All modules use IIFE pattern: (function(LV){ ... })(window.LV = window.LV || {}). Exports go on LV.ModuleName. LV.Data provides state/constants. LV.Game provides gamification engine with event bus (on/off/emit). LV.t(key) for i18n. LV.Audio.play(name) for SFX. LV.Confetti.celebrate() for confetti. LV.Charts.radar/line/pie for charts. CSS classes from style.css must be used exactly.
relevant_files: js/ui.js (TO CREATE - all 12 page renderers + overlays)
js/core.js (TO CREATE - router, nav, theme, modals, topbar)
js/app.js (TO CREATE - bootstrap, event wiring, service worker)
js/data.js (reference - LV.Data API, constants, state shape)
directory_structure: Flat structure: index.html at root, all JS in js/, icons in icons/, style.css + manifest.json + sw.js at root
